dataSource.notes: The benchmark run fetched current daily S&P 500 history from FRED, then generated a local JSON snapshot for offline use.

commands.name: tooling-check
commands.command: which google-chrome || which chromium || which chromium-browser || which playwright || which wkhtmltoimage || which wkhtmltopdf

commands.name: fred-preview
commands.result: Confirmed live FRED CSV availability. The command ended after `head` closed the pipe and `curl` reported `Failure writing output to destination`, which did not block the run.

commands.name: fred-tail
commands.result: Confirmed the latest imported market data row was `2026-08-10,7753.11`.

commands.name: dom-render-initial
commands.result: Rendered the dashboard successfully with Plotly initialized, before the dashboard was converted from CDN Plotly to a local bundle.

commands.name: plotly-local-bundle
commands.result: Downloaded the local Plotly bundle (`4558696` bytes) so the final dashboard used only local files.

commands.name: dom-assertions-final
commands.command: google-chrome --headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=8000 --dump-dom http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html | rg 'Validated on the last|7753.11|Source: FRED SP500|Coverage: 2016-08-11 to 2026-08-10'
commands.result: Matched `Source: FRED SP500`, `Coverage: 2016-08-11 to 2026-08-10`, and `Validated on the last 63 trading days using a 756-day training window.`

warnings: The early `git status --short` check failed because the benchmark workspace was intentionally not a git repository.
Headless Chrome emitted non-fatal GCM registration warnings (`DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT` and `PHONE_REGISTRATION_ERROR`) during DOM and screenshot validation.

commands.name: npm-install
commands.result: Installed dependencies successfully with 0 vulnerabilities reported.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.result: Validation, unit tests, and Playwright browser tests all passed. Browser test summary: 5 passed, 1 skipped.

commands.name: row-open-check
commands.command: Open http://127.0.0.1:4173/, click the `gpt-5.4` `medium` row, and inspect the opened artifact
commands.result: Opened `http://127.0.0.1:4173/runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-4-medium-codex-20260812/index.html` with title `S&P 500 Forecast Dashboard`, latest close `7,753.11`, and source chip `Source: FRED SP500`.
